entries.descriptionZh: '基于火山流式 ASR/TTS 的实时双工语音：回复朗读、打断、唤醒词、实时字幕、30 个中文音色与先响应后思考；在 DSH monorepo 内构建。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Real-time duplex voice over Volcengine streaming ASR/TTS: agent reply narration, barge-in, wake word, live captions, 30 Chinese voices and a reply-first acknowledgment; builds in the DSH monorepo.'

entries.descriptionZh: 面向 DSH 智能体的细粒度 LLM 验证：基于评分 token logprob 期望的成对打分、概率枢纽锦标赛 N 选一与逐步进度追踪。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Fine-grained LLM verification for DSH agents: pairwise rewards over score-token logprobs, Probabilistic Pivot Tournament best-of-N selection, and per-step progress tracking.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.'

entries.descriptionZh: 文件上传（彩色附件卡片、会话隔离存储、sha256 去重、TTL 清扫）+ 内容嗅探的 read_document 文档读取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）。
entries.descriptionEn: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.

entries.descriptionZh: 'DSH 环境只读体检：磁盘/内存/延迟/缓存膨胀/插件版本落后检测，分级报告并对比历史基线趋势。只读，不删任何东西。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Read-only DSH environment health check: disk, memory, latency, ~/.dsh bloat and outdated-plugin detection with graded reports and baseline trend comparison. Deletes nothing.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'DSH 插件的静态安全闸门与诊所：安装前静态审计、安装后哈希与能力锁定、本机指纹库与 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题的同类搜索、机械式剥离清理；永不执行目标插件。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Static-only plugin gate and clinic for DSH: audit before install, hash-and-capability lock after install, local fingerprint peer search over GitHub topic:dsh-plugin, and mechanical detox. Never executes the target plugin.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'DSH 极简片段/命令工具箱：5 个工具，一个可手工编辑的 JSONL 文件，零 UI、零数据库、零网络，只有明确说存才存。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Minimal snippet and command toolbox for DSH: five tools over a single human-editable JSONL file, zero UI, zero database, zero network, explicit save-only memory.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'DSH 一体化视觉创作工具链：提示词反推与审计优化，多供应商生图，支持异步后台出图。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Integrated visual creation toolchain for DSH: prompt reverse-engineering and audit optimization plus multi-provider image generation with async background rendering.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).'

entries.descriptionZh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。
entries.descriptionEn: 'DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.'

entries.descriptionZh: '让 DeepSeek Harness Agent 化身 GitHub 副驾：PR 审查、CI 失败修复、Issue 分类与自动发版说明。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'GitHub CI co-pilot for DeepSeek Harness: PR review, CI failure fixing, issue triage and release notes.'

entries.descriptionZh: '多视角深层结构分析技能：16 透镜 4 类别、10 个结构工具，先攻击默认立场，产出置信度校准、事实绑定的分层结论。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Multi-lens structural analysis skill: adversarial-first analysis across 16 lenses in 4 categories with 10 structural tools, confidence calibration, and fact-bound layered output.'

entries.descriptionZh: '将 DSH Web 直接呈现为可游玩的全屏第一人称 Minecraft 风格体素界面，而非只更换颜色的皮肤：用户可以在可持久化的 Three.js 方块世界中移动，并通过游戏内设施和工作台使用原生工作区、会话、对话、工具、模型选择、权限、上下文信息与输入框。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, a

entries.descriptionZh: 在 composer 输入框旁显示 5 家 AI 套餐用量与余额（MiniMax、DeepSeek、Kimi、OpenRouter、智谱），跟随当前模型自动切换，复用 DSH 模型设置里已配的 API Key。
entries.descriptionEn: Shows coding-plan usage and balance for 5 AI providers (MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu) beside the composer input, switching with the selected model and reusing API keys configured in DSH model settings.

entries.descriptionZh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, er

entries.descriptionZh: DSH 统一通知推送与远程控制：一个 `notify()` API 打通 25+ 渠道（Telegram / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 企业微信 / QQ 机器人 / WxPusher / PushPlus / Server 酱 / Bark / Discord / Slack / ntfy / webhook 等），timeSensitive / active / passive 分级路由并重试；五通道反向审批（Telegram 按钮 / 飞书卡片 / QQ / WxPusher / 微信 iLink）；QQ/钉钉/飞书官方扫码登录；本地 Web 管理台；多
entries.descriptionEn: 'Unified notification & remote control for DSH: one `notify()` API, 25+ channels (Telegram / DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom / QQ bot / WxPusher / PushPlus / ServerChan / Bark / Discord / Slack / ntfy / webhook...), level routing (timeSensitive / active / passive) with tiered retry, mu

entries.descriptionZh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.'

entries.descriptionZh: OpenMAIC 教学：课堂、幻灯片、交互组件与苏格拉底式教学。
entries.descriptionEn: 'OpenMAIC: classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.'

entries.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供仅回环的私有网关，支持 Tailscale Serve、Cloudflare Access 与 Headscale TCP Serve，精确主体白名单，引导式 fail-closed 配置。
entries.descriptionEn: Private loopback DSH Web gateway for Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Access, and Headscale TCP Serve, with exact principal allowlists and guided fail-closed setup.

entries.descriptionZh: 'A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH 网页皮肤管理器：可拖动的鲸鱼按钮，左键恢复默认界面，右键列出并切换所有已安装皮肤。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Skin manager for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a draggable whale button that restores the default look on left-click and switches between installed skins on right-click.'

entries.descriptionZh: Web UI 运行时插件加载：监视热目录，运行中安装/更新客户端插件 bundle，所有页面即时生效，免重启。附子智能体看板示例。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH Web GUI 字体切换器：99 个界面字体与 31 个代码字体，中西文自动搭配，即选即生效，localStorage 持久化。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Font switcher for the DSH Web GUI: 99 UI fonts and 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing stacks, instant apply and localStorage persistence.'

entries.descriptionZh: 为所有非官方（自定义）提供商的模型自动填充推理级别，数据来自 models.dev。
entries.descriptionEn: Automatically fills in reasoning-effort levels for models from unofficial (custom) providers, with data sourced from models.dev.

entries.descriptionZh: 输入框内 session 范围的 @文件/@文件夹提及：Git 感知索引、拖放与粘贴受管上传、经校验的路径标记。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：8 态 AI 状态灯 + 网页挂件 + 置顶透明 Electron 桌宠窗，表情/动作/气泡齐全，换模型自动适配。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.'

entries.descriptionZh: 定时任务：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。
entries.descriptionEn: Scheduled coding runs in fresh agent sessions with auditable history.

entries.descriptionZh: 计划批注：选中计划原文逐条批注，结构化反馈送回 Agent。
entries.descriptionEn: Plan review with anchored annotations and structured feedback back to the agent.

entries.descriptionZh: 自定义主题插件：支持视频与图片壁纸、自由拖动位置与拉伸填充模式；从壁纸提取主色并自动切换明暗字体；六个界面区域的模糊分别可调，分区不透明度可调；主题一键导出与导入。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Custom theme plugin with video and image wallpapers, free positioning, and scale/fill modes. Extracts wallpaper colours and switches text to light or dark automatically. Per-area blur across 6 UI regions, per-area opacity, and one-click theme export/import.'

entries.descriptionZh: '把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 产生的检查点变成时间线时间节点，任意两节点之间逐文件行级 diff；可从会话日志重放 trace 区间差异（无需快照生产者）；支持预览式工作区回滚与一次性撤销。提供 /diff、/rollback 命令、JSON HTTP API 与 GUI 面板。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /r

entries.descriptionZh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对 AI API 中转站和 LLM 代理运行本地安全审计，生成 Markdown 报告，覆盖提示词注入、模型替换信号、工具调用改写、错误泄漏、流完整性和按 profile 启用的 Web3 风险。
entries.descriptionEn: Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.

entries.descriptionZh: '代码研读教练：交互式引导研读论文对应的开源代码。五段研读法（锚定论文主张、地形扫描、入口追踪、核心映射、闭环验证），自动识别并告知语言的框架与架构，适合研读 AI 论文源码。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Interactive code-reading coach for DeepSeek Harness: a five-phase guided walkthrough of the source behind a paper, starting by identifying its language and framework.'

entries.descriptionZh: Cyberpunk 2077 / 夜之城主题：NC 黄 × 霓虹青配色、CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 悬停锁定、战斗状态 HUD、合成打字机与消息音效，以及隐藏彩蛋（relic / johnny）。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme: NC yellow and neon cyan identity, CRT scanlines, Kiroshi hover lock-on, combat-state HUD, synthesized typewriter and message SFX, and hidden easter eggs (relic / johnny).'

entries.descriptionZh: 移动端访问插件：经局域网/VPN 访问 Web GUI，含 PC 审批门禁、网络模式切换与移动端 UI 适配。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Mobile access plugin for the Web GUI: LAN/VPN access with a PC approval gate, network-mode switching and mobile UI adaptations.'

entries.descriptionZh: 一个赛博木鱼：可拖拽、点击敲击、累积功德的 Web 悬浮小摆件。
entries.descriptionEn: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.

entries.descriptionZh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.'

entries.descriptionZh: 持久化多模型小队在 Settings 中配置、从 Composer 选择，并支持逐成员模型与工具策略；主 Agent 为每次发送动态规划有界 DAG，并可执行有界的审阅/修复质量回路；Run Center 展示重试和基于 Harness 官方 usage 事件的逐成员 token 用量。
entries.descriptionEn: Persistent multi-model squads configured in Settings and selected in the Composer, with per-member model/tool policies; the main Agent dynamically plans each send as a bounded DAG with bounded reviewer/repair loops, while Run Center tracks retries and per-member tokens from offic

entries.descriptionZh: 通过可预览的五段式交接，将已有 DSH 会话迁移到另一个 Agent Preset；保留源会话，并可让目标会话暂停等待确认或立即继续。
entries.descriptionEn: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.

entries.descriptionZh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, an

entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.'

entries.descriptionZh: '确定性 AST 代码图谱与架构治理分析工具：调用链消歧、重构爆炸半径、循环依赖审计、领域切片与全栈 API 契约追踪。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API contracts.'

entries.descriptionZh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。
entries.descriptionEn: 'First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.'

entries.descriptionZh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.'

entries.descriptionZh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.'

entries.descriptionZh: '为了您的电脑安全，装插件前先体检：静态扫描恶意模式（外传/凭据/混淆/持久化）与高权限误用，覆盖传递依赖与官方包哈希基线（防供应链篡改），可选插件工具调用闸。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an o

entries.descriptionZh: '皮肤切换器：右上角一键切换主题，自动发现社区皮肤。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Skin switcher for the dsh web UI: one-click theme switching with auto-discovery of community skins.'

entries.descriptionZh: '给 Windows 文件管理器加右键项：把文件夹设为 DSH 工作区并切换到它，DSH 未运行会自动拉起。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.'

entries.descriptionZh: better-sidebar 音视频预览器：原生播放器内联播放 mp4/webm/mkv/mov 等视频与 mp3/flac/wav 等音频，自带支持 HTTP Range 拖动的流式媒体路由。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.'

entries.descriptionZh: VS Code 式工作区关键词搜索 Tab（better-sidebar 扩展）：同时匹配文件名与文件内容，结果按文件分组带行号，点击在侧栏编辑器打开。
entries.descriptionEn: 'VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.'

entries.descriptionZh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。
entries.descriptionEn: 'DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.'

entries.descriptionZh: 内嵌于 DSH Web GUI 的完整本地优先任务看板：看板/列表/Gantt/工作流/仪表盘视图、任务 AI 对话、附件与标签、dsh-routines 驱动的待办自动认领——数据存本地 SQLite（dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard）。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Full local-first issue board embedded in the DSH web GUI: Kanban / list / Gantt / workflow / dashboard views, AI chat per task, attachments and labels, auto-claim of todo tasks driven by dsh-routines — data lives in local SQLite (dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard).'

entries.descriptionZh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在 Web 设置面板中启用、停用、删除/撤回插件，并支持版本检测与 npm 插件更新；运行时开关持久化到 profile。
entries.descriptionEn: Toggle, delete, undo-delete, and check/update plugins from the Web settings panel; runtime enable/disable is persisted to the profile.

entries.descriptionZh: 对话旁的悬浮按钮，打开当前会话全部提问的可搜索列表并快速跳转；悬浮弹出/移出平滑关闭。
entries.descriptionEn: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps, with smooth hover-open/close behavior.

entries.descriptionZh: 为会话添加标签，并在 Web 设置面板中按标签搜索会话。
entries.descriptionEn: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.

entries.descriptionZh: 在 Web 设置面板中浏览、搜索、删除/撤回并更新用户技能，支持从 GitHub/Gitee Release 检查技能更新。
entries.descriptionEn: Browse, search, delete, undo-delete, and update user skills from the Web settings panel; checks GitHub/Gitee Releases for newer skill versions.

entries.descriptionZh: Web UI 鲸鱼娘壁纸背景，应用表面半透明磨砂；支持在设置页自定义图片、透明度与 contain/cover 铺放方式，远程图片自动预检并 no-referrer 加载。
entries.descriptionEn: Whale-girl wallpaper background with a frosted semi-transparent app surface; customize image, opacity, and contain/cover from the Web settings, with remote image preflight and no-referrer loading.

entries.descriptionZh: 输入框词自动补全：按前缀匹配与接近程度排序弹出当前会话词建议，↑/↓ 选择、回车确认。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Word auto-completion in the Web composer: prefix-matched suggestions sorted by closeness, arrow-key selection and Enter to confirm.'

entries.descriptionZh: 浮动在 DSH Web 页面上的 DeepSeek 蓝色小鲸鱼桌宠：可拖拽，说话气泡与心情姿势随互动切换，模型可调用 pet_say 工具让它开口，对话开始/结束时自动进入思考与庆祝状态。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在侧边栏会话菜单添加「删除」项，经二次确认后硬删除该会话。
entries.descriptionEn: Adds a "Delete" item to the sidebar session menu with a confirmation dialog, then hard-deletes the session.

entries.descriptionZh: 以结构化数据返回有界、相对仓库根的 Git 状态，不暂存、不提交，也不切换分支。
entries.descriptionEn: Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.

entries.descriptionZh: 模型驱动的上下文压缩（Active Context Pruning）：由模型决定何时压缩、压缩什么。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Model-driven context compression (Active Context Pruning) for DeepSeek Harness: the model decides when and what to compress.'

entries.descriptionZh: 跑步配速计算：根据距离与时间换算配速（分/公里）与速度（公里/小时）。
entries.descriptionEn: Running pace calculator: converts distance and time to min/km pace and km/h speed.

entries.descriptionZh: 把每轮 DSH Web 会话中的思考、工具调用和上下文合并为可展开的过程框，默认显示最新两项，同时把用户对话、交互式提问和最终回答留在框外。
entries.descriptionEn: Groups each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into an expandable process box that shows the latest two items by default, while keeping user dialogue, interactive questions and final answers outside.

entries.descriptionZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 本地归档会话中心：按工作区浏览、全文搜索并原生预览归档聊天，管理标签、备注和 ZIP 备份。删除前自动创建包含图片附件的保护快照并移入回收站，支持立即撤销、恢复、批量操作和明确的永久删除；所有数据始终留在本机。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Local archived-chat center for DeepSeek Harness: browse by workspace, search complete conversations, preview messages, tool activity and stored images, and manage metadata and ZIP backups. Deletion creates a verified protection snapshot and moves chats to a recoverable Recycle B

entries.descriptionZh: 一键让整个 DeepSeek Harness 界面通透起来：透明度滑块随心调，背景图自由换。
entries.descriptionEn: One toggle makes the whole DeepSeek Harness shell translucent, with an opacity slider and a custom full-page background.

entries.descriptionZh: '按内容语义压缩工具结果：13 个 reducer 在 tools/post-execute 阶段按含义裁剪超长输出（保留失败的测试、丢弃 diff 上下文、对 JSON 与 CSV 抽样、lint 问题按规则归类、依赖库的调用栈帧折叠、文件过多的目录只给计数），完整原文落盘保存并留一个定位符可取回。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Content-aware tool-result reducer: 13 reducers cut oversized output by meaning at tools/post-execute (failing tests kept, diff context dropped, JSON and CSV sampled, lint problems grouped by rule, dependency stack frames collapsed, crowded directories counted), with full origina

entries.descriptionZh: 将 CC Switch 中的 provider 和模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 provider 筛选和模型名称搜索。
entries.descriptionEn: Adds CC Switch providers and models to DeepSeek Harness, with provider filtering and model-name search.

entries.descriptionZh: '双色球助手 DSH 插件：千期趋势追踪、6 种预测模型与集成投票、组合结构分析、胆拖/随机选号，对话中直接调用 ssq 工具。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'SSQ (China Welfare Lottery Double Color Ball) helper for DeepSeek Harness: 1000-draw trend tracking, six prediction models with ensemble voting, structure analysis and dan-tuo/random generation via the ssq tool.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH Web 会话页实时大纲面板：「用户问题 + Markdown 标题（1~6 级）」大纲树，流式生成时实时更新，点击节点滚动定位并高亮，支持展开深度调节、搜索与会话级收藏。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Real-time outline panel for the DSH Web session page: user questions plus a Markdown heading tree (H1–H6) that updates live during streaming, with click-to-locate highlighting, expand-depth control, search, and per-session favorites.'

entries.descriptionZh: 设置页用量仪表盘：按服务商/模型汇总全部会话 token 用量，含今日/近 7 天/近 30 天趋势柱状图与缓存命中率。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Settings-page usage dashboard: per-provider/model token summary across all sessions, with today/7-day/30-day CSS-bar trends and a cache-hit rate.'

entries.descriptionZh: 把 ChatGPT（Codex）、Claude、Grok 订阅当作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方：设置页登录、模型目录、用量展示，以及 image_generate、video_generate 与 x_search 工具。
entries.descriptionEn: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.

entries.descriptionZh: 在输入框上方 dock 显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（5h 滚动/每周/每月窗口与重置倒计时），内置凭据编辑器。
entries.descriptionEn: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.

entries.descriptionZh: 诸天万界DSH：一个会话就是一本书。封面开书，十九界任选，文学预设只写正文，规则书按关键词注入，/export-story 把整场会话誊成 Markdown 小说。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Literary DSH plugin: one session is one book. Cover-card /new opens one of 19 realms, a prose-only 诸天万界DSH preset keeps the model writing fiction, keyword worldbook entries ground each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel.'

entries.descriptionZh: agent 树 token 预算管理。
entries.descriptionEn: Agent-tree token budget management.

entries.descriptionZh: 按 agent 的按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。
entries.descriptionEn: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.

entries.descriptionZh: 遥测后端：把 turns、model steps、tool calls 导出到 yiTrace。
entries.descriptionEn: Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.

entries.descriptionZh: 对话轮次导航。
entries.descriptionEn: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.

entries.descriptionZh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。
entries.descriptionEn: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.

entries.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 保存本地任务结果账本，依据确定性证据验证验收标准，记录用户处置与 token 用量，并支持摘要绑定导出。
entries.descriptionEn: Keeps a local task-outcome ledger for DSH, verifies acceptance criteria from deterministic evidence, records user disposition and token usage, and supports digest-bound export.

entries.descriptionZh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。
entries.descriptionEn: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-s

entries.descriptionZh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.'

entries.descriptionZh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。
entries.descriptionEn: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.

entries.descriptionZh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。
entries.descriptionEn: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.

entries.descriptionZh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示：输入框下方常驻徽章显示滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，点击展开进度卡片；Agent 可经 `opencode_go_usage` 工具随时查询余额。
entries.descriptionEn: 'OpenCode Go plan usage display for the DSH web GUI: a persistent badge under the composer shows rolling/weekly/monthly usage percents with reset countdowns; click to expand a card; agents can query the balance via the `opencode_go_usage` tool.'

entries.descriptionZh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。
entries.descriptionEn: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.

entries.descriptionZh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.'

entries.descriptionZh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。
entries.descriptionEn: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.

entries.descriptionZh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.'

entries.descriptionZh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.'

entries.descriptionZh: 面向 Agent 研究工作流的 Zotero 插件：搜索文献、查看元数据与笔记、提取与问题相关的证据段落、打开原文 PDF、生成引用与参考文献表。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Zotero as an evidence store for agents: search your library, inspect metadata and notes, retrieve evidence passages, open source PDFs, and generate citations and bibliographies.'

entries.descriptionZh: 官方风格输入框 + 浮动推理能力滑块弹窗，节点与滑块对齐，弹窗跟随 Harness 主题自适应。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Official-style composer model trigger with a floating reasoning-effort slider popup.'

entries.descriptionZh: PubMed 深度科研工具集：文献检索、作者调查、同名消歧、机构统计与师承匹配。
entries.descriptionEn: 'PubMed deep-research toolset: literature search, author investigation, same-name disambiguation, institution statistics and mentor-student matching.'

entries.descriptionZh: 浏览器标签页 favicon 实时反映 DSH 会话状态（待机 / 运行中 / 提问 / 完成）：单个 base.svg 在浏览器端上色与动画，颜色与特效均可在设置页配置。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.'

entries.descriptionZh: OpenAI Codex 与 DeepSeek Harness 一站式双向同步：一等公民技能、codex 会话导入与工作区挂载、codex mcp_servers 实时 MCP 自动镜像、Codex 侧反向 MCP 一键安装器。
entries.descriptionEn: 'One-stop bidirectional sync between OpenAI Codex and DeepSeek Harness: first-class skills from ~/.codex/skills, codex session import with workspace attach, live MCP auto-mirror of codex''s mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.'

entries.descriptionZh: '原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.'

entries.descriptionZh: '在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在 dsh web GUI 中读取 GeoServer WMS 服务并渲染地图图像，带服务器地址、用户名和密码设置卡片。
entries.descriptionEn: Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.

entries.descriptionZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端实现:扫码配对 + 端到端加密云端中继,把本机 dsh web 桥接到万宝盒 App。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.'

entries.descriptionZh: '面向模型的 image_describe（识图）工具（DashScope OpenAI 兼容接口，qwen3.7-flash）+ 粘贴桥：纯文本模型会话里粘贴的图片在发送时自动转为文件路径并在聊天记录中回显，不再触发图片准入拦截。自带 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY；端点/模型/预算可配置，重定向防护 HTTP 客户端，所有 Agent 预设均可用。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Model-facing image_describe (识图) tool over the DashScope OpenAI-compatible API (qwen3.7-flash), plus a paste bridge: on text-only sessions, pasted images auto-convert to file paths at send time and render back in the transcript, so they never trip image admission. Bring your own

entries.descriptionZh: '项目文档体系初始化 skill：提问驱动落实文档规范、固化 AI 协作工作流，跨 DSH / Reasonix / Claude Code / Codex 可用。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Project documentation scaffolding skill: question-driven setup of project standards, AI-collaboration workflows, and memory discipline across DSH, Reasonix, Claude Code, and Codex.'

entries.descriptionZh: 把随手记和待办写进工作区的 Markdown 文件里：/ml 加一句话就记进当天日志；待办分三种——截止日、睡到某天自动唤醒、随时；/ml view 打几个字母就能模糊打开任意文件。全程零 token，不经过大模型；笔记就是普通的本地文件，git 和任何编辑器都能直接用。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Notes and todos as plain Markdown files in your workspace: type /ml plus a sentence to jot into today''s journal; todos come in three flavors — deadline, sleep-until-a-date (auto-wakes when due), and anytime; /ml view fuzzy-opens any file with a few keystrokes. Zero tokens throu

entries.descriptionZh: 网页界面字体引擎：系统字体枚举、准星点选的全局与逐组件字号微调、设置页。老花眼友好，自定义字体和页面部件字体和字体大小，支持SPY模式扫UI和其他插件。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.'

entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。
entries.descriptionEn: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

entries.descriptionZh: 通过开源 wavespeed CLI 用 WaveSpeed 模型生成与编辑 AI 媒体（图像、视频、音频、3D）：实时目录搜索、逐模型输入 schema 自省、@path 标记本地文件上传、运行前价格查询。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Generate and edit AI media (image, video, audio, 3D) with WaveSpeed models via the open-source wavespeed CLI: live catalog search, per-model input-schema introspection, local-file upload with @path markers, and price checks before running.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在独立 Git worktree 中运行 3 或 5 个编码智能体候选，用项目命令验证补丁，只对通过者排序，并在应用获胜补丁前要求再次批准。
entries.descriptionEn: Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.

entries.descriptionZh: 'Bloom 莫兰迪主题：四款变体（雾蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、花瓣 petal、涟漪 ripple）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变，顶栏一键切换，八组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Bloom Morandi theme: four variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all eight foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better.'

entries.descriptionZh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。
entries.descriptionEn: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.

entries.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 聊天区右侧添加非等长非等距对话密度地图（历史聊天标签），一轮对话一个刻度，刻度长度与纵向距离反映消息大小，点击刻度可跳转至对应对话，标签繁杂时鼠标悬停会自动拉伸便于点击。
entries.descriptionEn: Adds a non-uniform conversation density map(chat history markers) to the right of the DSH chat area: one tick per turn, with tick length and spacing reflecting message size, clickable to jump to a turn and expanding on hover when crowded.

entries.descriptionZh: '在 DSH 里把任意 SVG logo 变成动效视频：`animate_svg` 工具渲染透明背景 30fps 组装动画（零件飞入或整体落位），并用 ffmpeg 合成 MP4。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH SSH 远程运维：通过 SSH 或一次性配对码的 remote-hostd 连接服务器，执行命令、管理后台任务、读写远程文件并审阅变更（host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes）。
entries.descriptionEn: 'SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes).'

entries.descriptionZh: 'MiniMax 多模态桥接：一个 `mmx_bridge` 工具覆盖图片理解/生成、视频、语音合成、音乐、翻唱、联网搜索与用量查询；可选接管 `web_search`/`read_image`；对话流直接内嵌播放器与图片预览（npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`）。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).'

entries.descriptionZh: 'obra/superpowers 的 DSH 完整移植：通过原生 SkillProvider（rank 550）注入 14 个方法论技能，覆盖需求澄清、计划拆解、TDD、系统化调试、并行分发等，文档全中文化，开箱即用、零构建安装。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Complete port of obra/superpowers for DeepSeek Harness: 14 methodology skills via a native SkillProvider (rank 550), covering brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging, parallel agents and more, with Chinese-localized docs and zero-build install.'

entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness 远程与移动端接入插件：支持局域网二维码、Cloudflare/自建公网隧道，以及微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 机器人实时交互与审批，内置访问安全门禁与防篡改控制。
entries.descriptionEn: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: supports LAN QR code, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, and WeChat, QQ, Feishu, and Telegram bots with approval cards and security access guards.

entries.descriptionZh: 微信（iLink）通道：用手机微信直接对话 DSH agent，每个对话一个持久会话，复用 DSH 凭据。
entries.descriptionEn: 'WeChat (iLink) channel: chat with your DSH agent from the WeChat app, one persistent session per conversation, reusing DSH credentials.'

entries.descriptionZh: '智能委派套件：按角色路由最强模型、失败自动互备、每个子代理可设思考强度、名字带模型标签、支持 fork 委派与可视化路由编辑。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Ranked subagent delegation: role-based model routing with failover, per-route reasoning effort, model-transparent labels, fork delegation, and a visual route editor.'

entries.descriptionZh: 项目与会话整理工具：支持多文件夹组合、待处理状态摘要、分组聊天搜索、原生目录选择、置顶、收藏、排序和归档中心。
entries.descriptionEn: Project and session organization with multi-folder groups, attention summaries, grouped chat search, native folder picking, pinning, favorites, ordering, and an archive center.

entries.descriptionZh: NewAPI（OpenAI 兼容网关）模型接入：注册 `newapi` 路由，仅发现聊天类模型，自动从 models.dev 获取模型参数（上下文窗口、思考强度等）并填充，并在 Web 设置页配置 base URL 与 API Key。
entries.descriptionEn: 'NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a `newapi` route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.'

entries.descriptionZh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理。
entries.descriptionEn: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows balance or rolling 5-hour and weekly usage, with per-provider visibility, alert thresholds and proxy support.

entries.descriptionZh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。
entries.descriptionEn: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.

entries.descriptionZh: 会话回合结束时播放短提示音，内置三种音色或一条自定义上传，在设置 → 插件中配置。
entries.descriptionEn: Plays a short chime when a conversation turn finishes, with three built-in tones or one custom upload, configured in Settings → Plugins.

entries.descriptionZh: '面向 PDF 文档的编辑插件,精确编辑PDF文字'
entries.descriptionEn: 'PDF document editing plugin for precise text editing in PDF files.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH 插件生态的社区搜索、相似度分析与安装/去重/自建决策工具。
entries.descriptionEn: Community search, similarity analysis, and install/dedupe/build-it-yourself decisions for the dsh-plugin ecosystem.

entries.descriptionZh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin''s own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.'

entries.descriptionZh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。
entries.descriptionEn: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.

entries.descriptionZh: OpenBiliClaw 的 DSH 消费侧插件：提供推荐、收藏列表、苏格拉底式对话、画像面板和 Agent Bridge 工具。
entries.descriptionEn: 'OpenBiliClaw consumer panel for DSH: recommendations, saved lists, Socratic dialogue, profile views, and Agent Bridge tools.'

entries.descriptionZh: Chat 和 Trajectory 旁的独立 Git Graph 视图：提交拓扑、本地/远程/tag 引用、HEAD 与工作区状态、搜索、筛选、首父模式、刷新和加载更多。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Dedicated read-only Git Graph view beside Chat and Trajectory: commit topology, local/remote/tag refs, HEAD and working-tree status, search, filtering, first-parent mode, refresh, and load more.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在组合框中使用 `@` 搜索并插入工作区文件和目录路径，并通过 `/h` 菜单复用当前会话的问题。
entries.descriptionEn: Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with `@`, plus a `/h` menu for reusing prompts from the current session.

entries.descriptionZh: 在飞书聊天里驱动 DeepSeek Harness agent：流式富卡片实时展示思考与工具步骤，按 DeepSeek 峰谷牌价计量每轮费用，一键审批、按模型能力透传图片，扫码即用、无需公网。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Feishu/Lark channel that drives DeepSeek Harness agents from chats: streaming rich cards with live thinking and tool steps, per-turn cost metering at DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates, one-tap approval cards, model-gated image intake, and QR onboarding without a public endpoint.'

entries.descriptionZh: 自进化：agent 在会话内给自己热挂载/卸载持久化插件。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.'

entries.descriptionZh: 用户与 agent 双向表情贴纸互动。
entries.descriptionEn: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.

entries.descriptionZh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.'

entries.descriptionZh: 动态壁纸插件：8 种内置 Canvas 壁纸（粒子、流星雨、星际穿梭、波光、雨幕、气泡、字符雨、极光）加自定义视频背景，支持速度/密度/遮罩/模糊调节，配置持久化。
entries.descriptionEn: Animated wallpaper plugin with 8 canvas backgrounds (particles, meteors, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, and speed/density/opacity/blur sliders with localStorage persistence.

entries.descriptionZh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH 页面悬浮的半透明 DeepSeek 鲸鱼小精灵：点击打开可拖动、可最小化的临时聊天浮窗，支持跟随会话模型或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点实时流式输出。
entries.descriptionEn: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.

entries.descriptionZh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。
entries.descriptionEn: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.descriptionZh: 'DSH Web GUI 安卓实机调试工作台：自动附加 logcat 流（级别/关键词过滤、崩溃自动快照），真机屏幕实时投屏与远程点击/滑动/文字操控，内存/进程/frida 逆向工具链，30 个 agent 工具。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.'

entries.descriptionZh: 左侧用户轮次导航轨道：随阅读位置高亮，悬停预览单轮指标与模型回答摘要，支持键盘和点击跳转及本地会话搜索。
entries.descriptionEn: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.

entries.descriptionZh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。
entries.descriptionEn: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.

entries.descriptionZh: 把内置 'Deep diving...' 思考状态行扩展为 53 条 deep 系英/中双语短语池：回合开场随机一条，随新思考段/工具调用事件轮换（最短间隔 3 秒），点击状态行切换中英文。
entries.descriptionEn: Rotates the model status line through a 53-phrase English/Chinese deep-theme pool: a random pick at turn start, event-driven switching on new thinking segments or tool calls (3s throttle), and a click on the status line toggles the language.

entries.descriptionZh: 自动折叠工具调用与 Think 段，回合结束后整回合收成一个大组头，实时显示耗时、token 消耗、tok/s 及缓存命中率等指标。
entries.descriptionEn: Automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into collapsible groups, then collapses each finished turn into a single header showing live duration, token consumption, throughput, and cache-hit metrics.

entries.descriptionZh: '多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在设置面板中管理 DSH Web 服务:状态、版本、重启、停止与一键更新。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.'

entries.descriptionZh: '面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语音输入插件：输入框的麦克风按钮把语音转成草稿文本，支持多种语音识别后端，可选经 dsh 自有 LLM 路由润色，并带原生设置页。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH Web 成就系统：画廊支持按分类/难度双排序、解锁 toast、侧栏奖杯、输入坞进度读条、联动成就，并本地持久化进度。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Achievement system for the DSH Web UI: gallery with category/rarity sorting, unlock toasts, sidebar trophy, composer dock, crossover achievements, and local persistence.'

entries.descriptionZh: Web UI 悬浮预览与代码窗口：Google AI Studio 风格的 iframe 预览（宽幅比/分辨率预设、一键放大），VS Code 风格代码窗支持直接编辑，保存需确认并写入会话日志。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.'

entries.descriptionZh: Web UI 按需 GitHub 代理：一键开关 git/SSH 代理并测试连通性。
entries.descriptionEn: On-demand GitHub proxy for the Web UI: one-click git/SSH proxy toggle with connectivity tests.

entries.descriptionZh: 点「新会话」默认打开绑定宿主启动目录的「默认目录」工作区（无需选文件夹），工作区选择菜单中也可选该项。
entries.descriptionEn: The generic New Session action opens a default-directory workspace instead of requiring a folder pick, and the workspace picker lists that workspace as a no-folder choice.

entries.descriptionZh: 为 Web UI 添加文件与文件夹拖放附件，提供输入栏卡片、持久化历史记录与工作区路径。
entries.descriptionEn: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.

entries.descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。
entries.descriptionEn: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

entries.descriptionZh: '从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'Git Worktree Session Target：任务在隔离 Session 中运行，支持 Ready for Review、可撤回的 Local Preview、人工确认交付、环境保留与恢复，以及同一 Session 连续迭代。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.'

entries.descriptionZh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环，以 MCP 接入。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight feedback loop — via MCP.'

entries.descriptionZh: 通过流拦截将部署级系统提示词段落与参考对话注入每次对话请求，附带 Web 设置面板。
entries.descriptionEn: Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.

entries.descriptionZh: 从 Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / GitHub / npm 导入并安装技能到 ~/.dsh/skills，模型自动读取、/技能名 立即可用；对话框旁 ⚡ 一键插入调用，设置页支持按来源/单技能导入、路径与数量展示、卸载与一键恢复。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Import, install and invoke Agent Skills in DeepSeek Harness from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub or npm — composer-side ⚡ picker inserts /skill-name into the draft, and a Skill 管理 settings page offers per-source/per-skill import, expandable source paths with skill counts, u

entries.descriptionZh: 在输入框新增图标按钮，一键调用当前模型把提示词优化得更清晰具体。
entries.descriptionEn: Adds an icon button to the composer that optimizes the current draft prompt through the active model.

entries.descriptionZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。
entries.descriptionEn: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.

entries.descriptionZh: 'Azure 资源管理：查询/展示资源、部署 Bicep/ARM 模板、查看活动日志。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Azure resource management: query and show resources, deploy Bicep/ARM templates, and check the activity log.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'OpenAI Codex CLI 封装：一次性任务、仓库审查与会话续接，默认只读沙箱。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper: one-shot exec, repo review and session resume with a default read-only sandbox.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'Grafana k6 压测：先冒烟再跑脚本，从 JSON 汇总读百分位数。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Load testing with Grafana k6: smoke-test first, then run scripts and read percentiles from the JSON summary.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'Kubernetes 运维：JSON 结构化查资源、describe、日志、exec、apply/delete（需确认）与端口转发。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.'

entries.descriptionZh: '微软 SkillOpt-Sleep 集成：夜间睡眠循环——收获会话、挖掘重复任务、重放并在留出验证门后沉淀技能。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Microsoft SkillOpt-Sleep integration: a nightly sleep cycle that harvests sessions, mines recurring tasks, replays them and consolidates validated skills behind a held-out gate.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'SSH 增强运维：连接测试、远程目录、ssh-config 导入、指纹检查与多主机批量执行。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Enhanced SSH ops: connectivity testing, remote ls, ssh-config import, known_hosts fingerprint checks and multi-host exec.'

entries.descriptionZh: '基础设施即代码：plan/apply 门控、state/output 检查与配置校验。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Infrastructure as code: gated plan/apply, state and output inspection, and configuration validation via the terraform CLI.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'Windows 包管理器：搜索、安装、升级、卸载、导入导出与版本固定。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Windows Package Manager: search, install, upgrade, uninstall, import/export and pin software through native tools.'

entries.descriptionZh: 为 DSH Desktop 增加系统托盘图标，可在设置中选择最小化或关闭时隐藏到托盘，应用更新后自动恢复。
entries.descriptionEn: Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.

entries.descriptionZh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.'

entries.descriptionZh: '开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.'

entries.descriptionZh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。
entries.descriptionEn: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.

entries.descriptionZh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on p

entries.descriptionZh: '**DeepSeek Chat（chat.deepseek.com）同款附件**：回形针上传按钮、240×64 DS 风格文件卡片（官方彩色文档图标，从 DS 前端 bundle 提取）、拖拽上传、文本提取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）注入消息、对话流中渲染真实附件卡片（自定义 user 渲染器）且模型读取完整内容。'
entries.descriptionEn: '**DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the m

entries.descriptionZh: 'llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategie

entries.descriptionZh: 内置 ChatGPT OAuth 的 Codex 模型提供方：可切换订阅联网搜索，在设置页显示普通 Codex 与 Spark 独立额度；无需 API Key，也不需要另装 Codex。
entries.descriptionEn: Built-in ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models, selectable subscription web search, backend quota for standard Codex and Spark, and a DSH settings UI; no API key or separate Codex installation required.

entries.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 原生侧边栏中管理归档会话，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。
entries.descriptionEn: Manages archived DSH sessions in the native sidebar with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.

entries.descriptionZh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。
entries.descriptionEn: Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.

entries.descriptionZh: 在 DSH Web 界面追踪 DeepSeek Token 用量、单次与会话费用及账户余额，并显示缓存感知的扣费动画。
entries.descriptionEn: Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.

entries.descriptionZh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.'

entries.descriptionZh: '`describe_image` 视觉桥：经 opencode Zen API（凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，免费线路优先、付费兜底）把图片发给 mimo-v2.5、返回文字描述给纯文本模型，原生格式直发，SVG/TIFF/HEIC 等格式经 ImageMagick 自动转码。'

entries.descriptionZh: 聊天表情包：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包。

entries.descriptionZh: 创意工坊式插件浏览器：侧栏常驻入口，搜索/最热/最新/近 7-90 天飙升榜、中文关键词映射、描述与 README 机翻、插件特征验证过滤、一键安装/更新。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Steam Workshop-style in-app plugin browser: search, hot/newest/trending (7/30/90-day) sorting, Chinese keyword mapping, bilingual descriptions and README translation, plugin-signature filtering, and one-click install/update.'

entries.descriptionZh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。
entries.descriptionEn: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.

entries.descriptionEn: 'Provides the bili_summary tool: Bilibili video metadata, subtitle timeline, and sharp-based frame capture with built-in error handling and graceful degradation.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在设置页、输入框下方读数条与可拖动悬浮按钮三处显示 DeepSeek 官方 API 余额与火山方舟 Coding/Agent Plan 套餐额度（5小时/周/月窗口及重置倒计时）。
entries.descriptionEn: Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh button.

entries.descriptionZh: 任务完成或需要确认/输入时发送操作系统原生通知：Windows toast、macOS osascript、Linux notify-send。
entries.descriptionEn: 'System-native notifications when a task finishes or needs your confirmation: Windows toast, macOS osascript, and Linux notify-send.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。
entries.descriptionEn: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.

entries.descriptionZh: 会话顶栏徽章：显示 DeepSeek Harness 当前版本，自动检查 npm 最新版本，有新版时提示升级。
entries.descriptionEn: Conversation header badge showing the DeepSeek Harness version, checking npm for the latest release and prompting upgrades.

entries.descriptionZh: 悬浮工作区文件树浏览器：带行号的代码语法高亮与 Markdown 富文本预览。
entries.descriptionEn: Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.

entries.descriptionEn: 'Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on

entries.descriptionZh: 通过 CDP 连接已运行的 Chrome/Edge：为 DSH 提供截图、像素断言、DOM/CSS 检查与页面 JS 执行，全程 HTTP + WebSocket、零子进程、零 npm 依赖、无需逐次授权。
entries.descriptionEn: 'CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.'

entries.descriptionZh: '角色皮肤舞台：雪乃·暖阳日常与隐秘年代志双主题，各带双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可视化装饰看板支持拖动/缩放/旋转/坐标精调/锚定切换/上传素材，装饰包（素材+布局）可导出分享、导入后自动打开看板继续调整。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).'

entries.descriptionZh: 通过 OAuth 连接 ChatGPT 账号，支持手动或自动切换，并为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带用量限额信息的 Codex 模型。
entries.descriptionEn: Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.

entries.descriptionZh: 'Codex 风格 /side 侧边对话插件：在当前对话旁开一个浮动分叉面板，继承上下文、不打断主任务。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.'

entries.descriptionZh: '给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'DSH Web 设置内的技能与 MCP 管理器：在项目级与用户级技能目录间浏览/启用/导入/删除技能，并管理 stdio/streamable-http 的 MCP 服务器（真实连接，工具注册为 mcp__<server>__<tool>，配置存 ~/.dsh/mcp.json）。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Skills & MCP manager in the DSH web settings: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, and manage stdio/streamable-http MCP servers with a real connection (tools registered as mcp__<server>__<tool>, config in ~/.dsh/mcp.json).'

entries.descriptionZh: '让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 扮演任何角色：全局扮演开关、酒馆 v2 角色卡（JSON 导入导出）、中立/角色化思考切换，内置 skill 支持一句话生成角色卡。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.'

entries.descriptionZh: 把 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）接入 DSH 作为产品子代理：用 Antigravity 登录态（无需 API key）委托 Gemini 编程智能体干活，支持对话续聊、后台流式进度、按路径识图与自动弹出登录窗口。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 设置里调整 LLM 自动重试的次数与退避时间并实时生效的设置卡片。
entries.descriptionEn: Settings card to tune the DSH LLM auto-retry policy (retry count, backoff, jitter) live from Settings → General.

entries.descriptionZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的 Bot 模式：把子 Agent 变成一群有头像、有人格的 Bot，每个 Bot 拥有独立对话，由一个持久的 continuable 子 Agent 会话支撑，跨轮次保留记忆。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Bot Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of named bots with avatars, personas and per-bot chats, each backed by one durable continuable subagent session that keeps memory across turns.'

entries.descriptionZh: 让 DSH 网页以无路径 @提及 附加任意类型文件：可从 @ 菜单挑选工作区文件，或拖入输入区，Agent 直接读取。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 Headroom 压缩代理的 token 与费用节省：设置页仪表盘 + 输入区常驻统计行。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.'

entries.descriptionZh: 在 DSH 会话中自动注入所选技能（如 caveman、ponytail）：每轮提示或仅在会话开始时，含设置页与输入区指示。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Auto-injects user-chosen skills into DSH sessions, either every prompt or once at session start, with a settings page and a composer indicator.'

entries.descriptionZh: DSH Web 右下角「余额」徽标：展开时读取当前所选提供方，显示 OpenCode Go 计划限额或 DeepSeek 预充值余额，并附本机 token 用量与按定价表估算的消费金额。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Bottom-right 余额 badge for the DSH Web UI: on expand it fetches the currently-selected provider''s OpenCode Go plan limits or DeepSeek prepaid balance, plus local token usage and pricing-based spend estimates.'

entries.descriptionZh: 字幕优先的视频转录与确定性抽取式 Markdown 总结；字幕不可用时回退到 faster-whisper `large-v3`。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Subtitle-first video transcription and deterministic extractive Markdown summaries, with a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.'

entries.descriptionZh: 侧边栏用量面板：把 Token 归属到实际服务该请求的中转站，站点从已有的 provider 配置中读出，无需额外配置；含今日/本月/累计三窗口、按站点与模型下钻、一年活跃度热力图，以及 New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek 余额。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances.'

entries.descriptionZh: 'SSH 远程执行插件集：把会话工作区指向 ssh:// 目录，文件读写、命令与 shell 全部在远程主机上执行。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'SSH remote execution set: give a session an ssh:// workspace and every file, command, and shell operation runs on the remote host.'

entries.descriptionZh: 设计美学技能包：10 种风格（深色 SaaS、极简白、新拟态、粗野主义、毛玻璃、日式极简、便当盒、赛博朋克、蒸汽波、装饰艺术），每种含 token、组件规则、禁用清单与验收清单，附可运行落地页 demo。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Design-aesthetics skill pack (10 styles: dark SaaS, minimal white, neumorphism, brutalism, glassmorphism, Japanese minimal, bento grid, cyberpunk, vaporwave, art deco) with runnable landing-page demos: tokens, component rules, forbidden lists, and acceptance checklists per style

entries.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计。按渠道区分统计，官方渠道自动显示余额，套餐渠道显示 5 小时/7 天/30 天用量余量，人民币计费估算，含每日图表与模型分布，集成在设置页侧边菜单。
entries.descriptionEn: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.

entries.descriptionZh: 金融研究工作流与组合风控工具，对当前市场事实强制来源与时间戳边界。
entries.descriptionEn: Financial research workflow and portfolio risk tools with source discipline for current market facts.

entries.descriptionZh: 输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读，朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。
entries.descriptionEn: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.

entries.descriptionZh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.'

entries.descriptionZh: '检测并修复 dsh 启动的 "duplicate loader entry id" 崩溃：扫描 profile 各 bundle 的重复 loader row，转换为 id-targeted patch，附带零依赖 CLI（检测/预览/修复/复检）。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Diagnoses and fixes "duplicate loader entry id" boot crashes - finds duplicate loader rows across profile bundles and converts them into id-targeted patches via a zero-dependency CLI (detect / preview / fix / verify).'

entries.descriptionZh: 带血缘的决策与目标记忆：显式命令与模型工具确定性记录决策，状态卡跨压缩重锚定，无损事件流 + BM25 分词检索兜底，场景级保真回归集作发布门禁。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates release

entries.descriptionZh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。
entries.descriptionEn: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.

entries.descriptionZh: 系统级桌面通知：回合完成 / 工作流完成横幅，需要审批时弹出模态提醒（macOS osascript / Linux notify-send）。
entries.descriptionEn: 'System-level desktop notifications: turn-completion and workflow-end banners, plus a modal alert when an approval is needed (macOS osascript / Linux notify-send).'

entries.descriptionZh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.'

entries.descriptionZh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。
entries.descriptionEn: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).

entries.descriptionZh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).'

entries.descriptionZh: 'DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；同时提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 工具。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source root, nested flag, model/user invocation state), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, and enable or disable model/user invocation — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* tools.'

entries.descriptionZh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。
entries.descriptionEn: 'One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.'

entries.descriptionZh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.'

entries.descriptionZh: '微信读书多目标导出：通过官方 Skills API Key 查看书架、导出划线/想法到 flomo、本地 Markdown 或 Notion，可选按自定义 LLM prompt 整理后再导出。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to flomo, a local Markdown file, or Notion, optionally reworked by a configurable LLM prompt.'

entries.descriptionZh: 多 Agent 深度长文流水线技能包：8 角色 + 5 阶段，文献/数据/案例三线并行检索 + T8 批判伙伴 + M 门终检，产出带证据底座、反方论证、独立审计（G0-G13）与人工核验节点的深度文章/论文。
entries.descriptionEn: Multi-agent deep long-form article pipeline skill for DeepSeek Harness, running 8 roles across 5 phases with parallel literature/data/case retrieval, a critical-companion review, M-Gate mechanical final check, independent G0-G13 audit and human verification gates.

entries.descriptionZh: 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。
entries.descriptionEn: 'Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layo

entries.descriptionZh: '面向 DSH 的点对点同事 Agent 咨询：可向单个或多个已配置 Peer 提问、异步排队问题、通过签名 Friend Card 推荐发现 Peer，并在 Web UI 审批入站请求。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.'

entries.descriptionZh: '水豚秘书：桌面宠物气泡+叮咚通知、告警收件箱 API、会话智能提醒（任务完成/需要确认/阻塞）、磁盘/HTTP/进程巡检脚本，以及每日高口碑插件推荐，另附 API 冒烟测试。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Capybara secretary for DSH: desktop pet notifications with ding sound, alert inbox API, session-aware alerts (turn done / approval needed / turn blocked), check scripts, and daily high-star plugin recommendations.'

entries.descriptionZh: '选中聊天回复中的任意文字，浮出「追问/复制」气泡：一键把选中内容作为引用填入输入框（问题由你输入），或一键复制。另附安装与实现文档。'
entries.descriptionEn: 'Select any text in a DSH chat reply to get a floating Follow-up/Copy pill: one click quotes the selection into the composer so you can type your own follow-up question, or copies it.'
